description: Requests the open tabs made (recorded automatically, newest last): id, tab, method, status, type, MIME, size, URL. By default only API/document traffic (XHR, Fetch, Document); filter by urlIncludes/method/status, or sinceLastAction for what the previous action triggered. Read a body with response_body.

sinceLastAction.description: Only requests seen since the previous tool call started.

status.description: Exact HTTP status; 0 = no response yet / failed.

types.description: Resource types, e.g. ["XHR","Fetch","Document","Script","Image"]. Default XHR, Fetch, Document.

name: network_requests
